facts.premium: Around the southern norm; a strong plantation economy with notably high pickup ownership.
facts.skill_gap: Farm-skewed labour; modest formal manufacturing (~15k factory workers).
anchors: Oil palm — a leading palm province
Fruit (durian is a major export crop)
Agro-processing and the gateway to the South
workers: Pickup-owning farmers and produce haulers (26% pickups — highest in the South)
impacts: Highest pickup share in the South (26%) — durable, liquid farm-vehicle collateral.
Premium durian exports lift orchard incomes and borrowing capacity in good years.
Falling palm FFB prices pressure the dominant farm income.
Tapping income adds a second commodity-price dependency.
Heavy reliance on a few crops means correlated income shocks across districts.
Chumphon sits on a storm/flood path; weather can wipe out a harvest season.
